Clinical Treatment Summary
The patient was seen after a collision that occurred while the patient was turning left, in which the head struck a side
component of the vehicle. The reported mechanism and force of imapct fit the concussion diagnosed. Over 21 visits,
care followed a typical course that included symptom monitoring, guidance on cognitive rest, and gradually increased
activity. Visit frequency tapered as the patient reported improvement. Most of the documented findings rest on the
patient's own descriptions of pain and symptoms. Imaging studies and neurological examination tests have been
within normal limits. The patient was also treated for the same body region within the past two years, and that earlier
condition may add to some of the current complaints. Two similar billing entries recorded on the same day are under
review. The patient is expected to return to normal activities as symptoms resolve.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.

- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
